policy.conversion: Original marked dictionary syllables preserved byte-for-byte, including ü, combining marks and neutral tones. Original/protected text unchanged.
special_rules: Unmatched 了 after no dictionary character is liǎo.
々 repeats the previous dictionary first reading, otherwise tóng.
Dictionary underlying tones; no blanket third-tone or 一/不 surface-sandhi rewrite.
policy.selection: Pinned upstream phrase probability/tie selection plus bounded explicit traditional phrase aliases. Character defaults are not contextual certainty.
policy.word_joins: Reviewed words join only when selected reading syllables match; other boundaries remain syllable-separated.
